negative_findings.description: Searched in Slovenian for public service-status / incident pages for SI payment infrastructure (Bankart, Flik, bank online banking). No dedicated status.* page or machine-readable incident feed was located; Bankart directs users to email/phone support and banks publish outage notices as ad-hoc news items.
negative_findings.result_summary: No status.bankart.si-style page discovered; only support and product pages plus per-bank notice sections.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Status pages are usually the cheapest real-time deployment/incident signal. Their apparent absence means outage-based inference must fall back on bank news pages, app-store reviews and forum reports, which are noisier and slower.

negative_findings.description: Explicit searches (sl and en) for SI bank job ads naming Temenos T24, Oracle FLEXCUBE, Finastra, Mambu, Backbase or similar returned no Slovenian ad. Results were dominated by non-SI content and generic vendor-comparison articles.
negative_findings.result_summary: Zero confirmed SI vacancy naming a specific core-banking product in this discovery pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: This is a discovery-method limitation, not evidence that such ads do not exist: search engines index SI job boards poorly and ads expire quickly. It argues for on-site crawling of the boards themselves rather than relying on web search.

negative_findings.description: Careers/job pages were confirmed for Bankart; equivalents for Halcom, SRC d.o.o. and Asseco SEE Slovenia were not surfaced by the searches performed in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only Bankart's vendor careers section confirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Integrator-side hiring (Halcom, SRC, Asseco) is often the earliest signal of a bank project win; missing those pages leaves a hole on the supply side of the cell.

negative_findings.description: All candidates were identified via search-result evidence; individual URLs were not fetched one-by-one in this pass, so reachability is unverified by design.
negative_findings.result_summary: URLs recorded with confidence scores, not liveness claims.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Downstream deterministic verification must run before any URL is treated as live; treat 403/timeouts as bot defence rather than death.

coverage_gaps.description: PSD2/developer portals not yet pinned for several SI ASPSPs: Nova KBM/SKB legacy entities post-OTP merger, LON (Hranilnica LON), Primorska hranilnica Vipava, N26/Revolut-style non-bank PSPs operating in SI, and BKS Bank SI.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate the full ASPSP list from Banka Slovenije's register and from the Bankart hub tenant paths, then locate each entity's PSD2 page.

coverage_gaps.description: No technical fingerprinting layer defined yet (TLS certificate SANs, HTTP response headers, JS bundle vendor strings, mobile app binary/SDK inspection) — the highest-yield way to read a vendor off a portal that names no vendor.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a passive fingerprinting routine over the confirmed portal hostnames plus APK/IPA metadata for the SI banking app roster; certificate-transparency logs can also reveal new sandbox/API hostnames before launch.

coverage_gaps.description: Job ads and app release notes are ephemeral; nothing in the current source set guarantees historical retention.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair every job-board and app-store source with archival (own snapshot store plus Wayback save-page-now) so the dated-evidence property of the cell survives.

coverage_gaps.description: Local-language searching was performed throughout, but no glossary yet exists for the SI-specific terms for card/ATM processing roles and core-banking modules, which limits recall on job boards.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build a sl glossary: jedrni bančni sistem, kartično poslovanje, procesiranje kartic, plačilni promet, takojšnja plačila, odprto bančništvo, peskovnik, razvijalski portal, ponudnik plačilnih storitev, hranilnica; flag noisy terms ('banka' matches Banka Slovenije, 'razvoj' matches business development).

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn — probably the richest weak-signal source for this cell — is login-walled and ToS-restricted, so systematic collection is not permissible by scraping.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide between licensed access (Sales Navigator / Talent Insights) or a documented manual-analyst review cadence; record the choice so downstream collection stays compliant and GDPR-safe.

brief: Slovenia's indirect vendor-signal landscape is unusually concentrated: openbanking.bankart.si acts as a multi-tenant PSD2 hub for most domestic banks (Gorenjska banka, Sparkasse, Delavska hranilnica, OTP SI), while NLB, Addiko, Intesa Sanpaolo and UniCredit run their own or group-level developer portals — so which portal a bank uses is itself a vendor disclosure. Two concrete weak signals surfaced in this pass: a Bankart-hosted API product described as the 'SRC PSD2 API Collection', and an NLB-group Android package id containing 'asseco'. On the recruitment side, Bankart's own job ads are the richest named-technology source found, with Optius, MojeDelo, the state ZRSZ vacancy register, Careerjet and bank careers pages as the collection layer; LinkedIn is the highest-value but access-restricted channel. The main gaps are the absence of any public status page for SI payment infrastructure, no technical-fingerprinting routine yet, and no archival guarantee for ephemeral job ads and release notes.
